description: How to write anything a person reads: README sections and docs pages, upgrade and release notes, changelogs, issue and PR comments, PR descriptions, plan files, reviews and triage notes. Lead with the point, plain words, concise without losing detail, and no restating what a table or screenshot shows. Use whenever you write or revise prose for a human reader, in a file or in a reply. Not for code comments, commit messages or executable specs.
